description: Abstract class for installer Vue controllers managing different installation and upgrade screens, rendering templates, and handling request context.

classes.name: AbstractInstallerVueController
classes.description: Abstract base class for installer Vue controllers, managing rendering and request context for installation and upgrade screens.

methods.name: getTwig
methods.description: Returns the Twig environment used for rendering templates.

methods.name: setTemplate
methods.description: Sets the template filename for rendering.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Sets the Vue component associated with the controller.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the AttributeBag used for rendering context.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialization method, meant to be overridden.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Hook executed before rendering, can be overridden.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the template with context data.

methods.name: postRender
methods.description: Hook executed after rendering, can be overridden.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the rendering process and returns a response.

methods.name: getAssetsVersion
methods.description: Returns version string for assets, based on build file timestamp or current timestamp.

methods.name: getSteps
methods.description: Determines the sequence of steps based on whether it's an upgrade or fresh install.

methods.name: getCurrentStep
methods.description: Calculates the current step index based on the current screen.
